rows.first_problematic_claim: By the Baire category theorem, at least one of A or B has non-empty interior.
rows.failed_obligation: Baire category only rules out both sets being nowhere dense; a set may have empty interior without being nowhere dense.
rows.minimal_repair_direction: Replace this with a valid argument for arbitrary two-colourings of R; do not infer that either colour contains an interval from Baire category.
rows.reason: For example, Q and R\Q partition R and both have empty interior, although R\Q is not nowhere dense. The interval construction afterward is valid only conditionally.
